Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, sh As Object, s As String, v As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 1
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddTextbox(msoTextOrientationHorizontal, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 2
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddLine(10, 10, 110, 50)
    Case 3
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 100, 40)
        sh.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(255, 0, 0)
    Case 4
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 100, 40)
        sh.Fill.Visible = msoFalse
    Case 5
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 100, 40)
        sh.Fill.Visible = msoFalse: sh.Fill.Visible = msoTrue
    Case 6
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 100, 40)
        sh.Fill.Transparency = 0.5
    Case 7
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 100, 40)
        sh.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(0, 128, 255): sh.Fill.Transparency = 0.25
    Case 8
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 100, 40)
        sh.Fill.Solid
    Case 9
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 100, 40)
        sh.Line.Visible = msoFalse
    Case 10
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 100, 40)
        sh.Line.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(0, 255, 0)
    Case 11
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 100, 40)
        sh.Line.Weight = 3
    Case 12
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 100, 40)
        sh.Line.Weight = 2.25: sh.Line.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(1, 2, 3)
    Case 13
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 100, 40)
        sh.Line.DashStyle = msoLineDash
    Case 14
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 100, 40)
        sh.Line.Transparency = 0.5
    Case 15
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddTextbox(msoTextOrientationHorizontal, 10, 10, 100, 40)
        sh.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(255, 255, 0)
    Case 16
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddTextbox(msoTextOrientationHorizontal, 10, 10, 100, 40)
        sh.Fill.Visible = msoFalse
    Case 17
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddTextbox(msoTextOrientationHorizontal, 10, 10, 100, 40)
        sh.Line.Visible = msoFalse
    Case 18
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddTextbox(msoTextOrientationHorizontal, 10, 10, 100, 40)
        sh.Line.Weight = 2
    Case 19
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddLine(10, 10, 110, 50)
        sh.Line.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(255, 0, 0)
    Case 20
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddLine(10, 10, 110, 50)
        sh.Line.Weight = 4
    Case 21
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddLine(10, 10, 110, 50)
        sh.Line.DashStyle = msoLineRoundDot
    Case 22
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddLine(10, 10, 110, 50)
        sh.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(255, 0, 0)
    Case 23
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 100, 40)
        sh.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = -1
    Case 24
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 100, 40)
        sh.Line.Weight = -1
    Case 25
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 100, 40)
        sh.Fill.Transparency = 2
    End Select
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Fill.Visible
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Fill.Transparency
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Fill.Type
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Fill.BackColor.RGB
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Fill.ForeColor.ObjectThemeColor
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Fill.ForeColor.Type
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Line.Visible
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Line.ForeColor.RGB
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Line.Weight
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Line.DashStyle
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Line.Style
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Line.Transparency
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Line.ForeColor.ObjectThemeColor
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(sh.Fill)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(sh.Line)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(sh.Fill.ForeColor)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(sh.Fill.Parent)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Tried = "ok " & Mid(s, 2)
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 25
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
